title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-a4n2.3: tx_queue_destroy not called in lichen_link_cleanup
description:
lichen_link_cleanup() (link_ctx.c:572-597) destroys ctx->seq_lock on POSIX (line 594) but never calls tx_queue_destroy(&ctx->tx_queue). The tx_queue has its own pthread_mutex_t on POSIX, initialized by tx_queue_init(). On every link context cleanup (e.g., re-initialization in lichen_l2.c error paths), the queue's mutex is leaked.

Fix: add tx_queue_destroy(&ctx->tx_queue) to lichen_link_cleanup(), wrapped in #ifndef __ZEPHYR__ (matching the existing pattern for seq_lock destruction). The queue state (entries, stats) can be cleared via memset just as the existing code does for other struct fields.
